# Helper function to find Dropbox path

```{r find_dropbox}
get_dropbox_path <- function() {

  # Dropbox stores its configuration in info.json
  # This works for both personal and team Dropbox accounts

  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
    # On Windows, check both APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA
    info_paths <- c(
      file.path(Sys.getenv("APPDATA"), "Dropbox", "info.json"),
      file.path(Sys.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA"), "Dropbox", "info.json")
    )
  } else {
    # On Mac/Linux
    info_paths <- file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".dropbox", "info.json")
  }

  # Find the first existing info.json
  info_path <- NULL
  for (p in info_paths) {
    if (file.exists(p)) {
      info_path <- p
      break
    }
  }

  if (is.null(info_path)) {
    stop("Could not find Dropbox info.json. Is Dropbox installed?")
  }

  # Read the JSON file
  info <- fromJSON(info_path)

  # Prefer business/team Dropbox if available, otherwise use personal
  if (!is.null(info$business)) {
    return(info$business$path)
  } else if (!is.null(info$personal)) {
    return(info$personal$path)
  } else {
    stop("Could not find Dropbox path in info.json")
  }
}

# Get the Dropbox path
dropbox_root <- get_dropbox_path()
message("Found Dropbox at: ", dropbox_root)
```

# Download NUTS1 data from BigQuery

```{r download_nuts1}
# Set your project ID
project_id <- "patbis"

# Specify dataset and table name
# Note: table is named nuts2 but actually contains NUTS1 codes (3 chars)
dataset <- "spatial"
table <- "docdb_nuts2_v3"

# Download the entire table
docdb_nuts1 <- bq_table_download(
  bq_table(project_id, dataset, table)
)


# Rename region_code to nuts1_code for clarity
docdb_nuts1 <- docdb_nuts1 %>%
  rename(nuts1_code = region_code)

# Preview the data
head(docdb_nuts1)
```

# Filter to keep only families in countrymap

```{r filter_countrymap}
# Read countrymap.fst from Dropbox
countrymap_path <- file.path(dropbox_root, "Apps", "iseapp", "countrymap.fst")
countrymap <- read_fst(countrymap_path)

# Filter to keep only docdb_family_ids that exist in countrymap
n_before <- nrow(docdb_nuts1)

docdb_nuts1 <- docdb_nuts1 %>%
  semi_join(countrymap, by = "docdb_family_id")

n_after <- nrow(docdb_nuts1)

message("Filtered from ", n_before, " to ", n_after, " observations")

# Show distinct NUTS1 regions after filtering
docdb_nuts1 %>%
  distinct(nuts1_code) %>%
  arrange(nuts1_code)
```

# Add NUTS1 region names

```{r add_region_names}
# UK NUTS1 region lookup table
nuts1_names <- tibble::tribble(
  ~nuts1_code, ~nuts1_name,
  "UKC", "North East England",
  "UKD", "North West England",
  "UKE", "Yorkshire and The Humber",
  "UKF", "East Midlands",
  "UKG", "West Midlands",
  "UKH", "East of England",
  "UKI", "London",
  "UKJ", "South East England",
  "UKK", "South West England",
  "UKL", "Wales",
  "UKM", "Scotland",
  "UKN", "Northern Ireland"
)

# Join region names to the data
docdb_nuts1 <- docdb_nuts1 %>%
  left_join(nuts1_names, by = "nuts1_code")

# Preview
head(docdb_nuts1)

# Check for any unmatched codes
unmatched <- docdb_nuts1 %>%
  filter(is.na(nuts1_name)) %>%
  distinct(nuts1_code)

matched <- docdb_nuts1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(nuts1_name)) %>%
  distinct(nuts1_code)


if (nrow(unmatched) > 0) {
  warning("Unmatched NUTS1 codes: ", paste(unmatched$nuts1_code, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("All NUTS1 codes matched to region names")
}

message("Matched NUTS1 codes: ", paste(matched$nuts1_code, collapse = ", "))

# Keep only matched codes
docdb_nuts1 <- docdb_nuts1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(nuts1_name))
```

# Save to local Dropbox

```{r save_fst}
# Define the output path in Dropbox Apps/iseapp folder
output_path <- file.path(dropbox_root, "Apps", "iseapp", "docdb_nuts1.fst")

# Create directory if it doesn't exist
dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Write the data as fst file
write_fst(docdb_nuts1, output_path, compress = 100)

message("Data saved to: ", output_path)
```
